title: 4. Preposition & Aturan Ketergantungan
group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: Preposition untuk waktu, tempat, dan arah, preposition untuk data di Task 1, dependent preposition yang perlu dihafal per kelompok, dan kesalahan terjemahan langsung yang menandai sebuah tulisan sebagai tulisan kandidat Bangladesh.

Preposition adalah kata-kata kecil (in, on, at, by, for, to, of, from, with) yang menunjukkan hubungan antar kata dalam hal waktu, tempat, dan arah. Kelihatannya sepele, tetapi preposition menyumbang banyak sekali kesalahan dalam tes ini, karena satu alasan: preposition dihafal berdasarkan pola, bukan logika. Tidak ada aturan yang menjelaskan mengapa bahasa Inggris mengatakan interested in tetapi good at dan afraid of. Ini adalah collocation tetap, dan terdengar benar atau tidak di telinga penutur asli. Bagi penutur bahasa Bangla, ini masalah, karena naluri Anda adalah menerjemahkan preposition bahasa Bangla secara langsung, padahal bahasa Bangla memetakan hubungan-hubungannya dengan cara yang berbeda.
4.1 Apa fungsi preposition (tanpa asumsi apa pun)

Preposition terletak sebelum noun atau pronoun dan menunjukkan sebuah hubungan: the book is on the table (tempat), the meeting is at three (waktu), she walked into the room (arah). Noun sesudahnya disebut object-nya. Satu aturan penting yang sudah Anda temui di bab tense muncul lagi di sini: setelah preposition, verb selalu memakai bentuk -ing, tidak pernah infinitive. Interested in studying, responsible for managing, capable of solving.
4.2 Preposition waktu · in, on, at, dan teman-temannya
Tiga preposition waktu utama mengikuti logika “zooming in”, dari periode panjang ke titik yang persis.
bulan, tahun, musim, abad, periode panjang
in July, in 2020, in winter, in the 1990s
on Monday, on 5 May, on weekdays
at 5 p.m., at night, at the weekend, at the start
Preposition waktu lain yang penting untuk IELTS:
since + titik awal (dipakai bersama present perfect): since 2010, since January.
for + lamanya waktu: for five years, for a decade.
during + sebuah periode (saat sesuatu terjadi di dalamnya): during the 1990s, during the recession.
by + batas waktu (tidak lebih lambat dari): by 2030, by the end of the decade.
from … to / until + sebuah rentang: from 2000 to 2010, until 2015.
In Monday the shop is closed. / The population grew since five years.
On Monday the shop is closed. / The population grew for five years.
in = di dalam ruang atau area: in the room, in Dhaka, in the world.
on = di atas permukaan atau garis: on the wall, on the coast, on the second floor.
at = di titik atau tempat tertentu: at the station, at the top, at home.
into / onto / to untuk menunjukkan gerakan atau arah: walk into the room, climb onto the roof, go to work.
The figures are shown in the chart, on the vertical axis, at the top of the page.
4.4 Preposition untuk data di Task 1 (hafalkan sebagai frasa tetap)
Kombinasi ini menggambarkan pergerakan dan jumlah pada grafik. Semuanya wajib benar di Writing Task 1, dan examiner mengharapkan setiap kombinasi dipakai dengan tepat.
Sales increased with 20 per cent and reached to a peak in June.
Sales increased by 20 per cent and reached a peak in June.
“increase by” sebuah persentase; “reach a peak” tidak memakai preposition setelah “reach.”
Satu kalimat Task 1 yang kuat sering merangkai beberapa kombinasi ini: The price rose by five dollars, from 20 to 25, reaching a peak of 25 in March.
4.5 Dependent preposition (preposition yang mengikuti kata tertentu)

Banyak verb, adjective, dan noun diikuti oleh preposition tetap. Tidak ada logikanya; Anda mempelajari masing-masing sebagai satu kesatuan. Hafalkan per kelompok dan pakai terus sampai terasa otomatis.
The policy resulted in higher costs.
The panel consists of five experts.
The essay focuses on two causes.
Families struggle to cope with rising costs.
Individuals are responsible for their choices.
People are more aware of the risks.
The system is capable of handling demand.
This trend is similar to the previous one.
Urban life is different from rural life.
He is good at solving problems.
The economy is dependent on exports.
The issue is related to poverty.
The course is suitable for beginners.

Ini adalah kesalahan spesifik yang muncul karena menerjemahkan struktur bahasa Bangla kata demi kata. Kesalahan ini sangat umum dan langsung dikenali oleh examiner, jadi memperbaikinya memberi peningkatan akurasi yang cepat dan terlihat.

discuss / enter / reach / marry langsung memakai object — tanpa preposition
✗ discuss about the topic / enter into the room / reach to the destination / marry with her
✓ discuss the topic / enter the room / reach the destination / marry her

according to me / return back / comprise of / mention about / cope up with — semuanya salah
✗ According to me / return back home / comprise of three parts / mention about it / cope up with
✓ In my opinion / return home / comprise three parts / mention it / cope with

Preposition memengaruhi skor Anda di dua tempat yang terlihat. Di Writing Task 1, preposition data (by, from, to, of, at) begitu standar sehingga satu kesalahan langsung menonjol sebagai kesalahan akurasi. Di Writing Task 2 dan Speaking, dependent preposition (depend on, lead to, responsible for, solution to) dan kesalahan terjemahan langsung (discuss about, according to me) membedakan bahasa Inggris yang terkendali dari yang tidak. Karena semuanya adalah collocation, pemakaian yang benar juga menaikkan skor Lexical Resource Anda, jadi manfaatnya ganda.

Skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: Unemployment rose by four points, from six to ten per cent, before falling to eight in 2015.
Task 2: A lack of investment in public transport contributes to congestion and leads to higher emissions.
Speaking Part 3: It really depends on the situation, but on balance I think education is the solution to most of these problems.
Akhir Bab 4, dan akhir Modul 1. Berikutnya Modul 2 (Struktur Kompleks Band 7.0+), Bab 5.

title: 4. Practice · Preposition & Aturan Ketergantungan
group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: Banyak verb, adjective, dan noun terikat pada preposition tertentu tanpa logika di balik pasangannya -- Anda cukup menghafal masing-masing sebagai satu kesatuan tetap: depend ON, responsible FOR, an increase IN.

**Mengapa ini penting:** Dependent preposition murni hafalan, tetapi ada di mana-mana dalam academic writing, dan kesalahan di sini terbaca sebagai kesalahan dasar bahkan dalam kalimat yang sebenarnya kuat.
Pelajari per kelompok, berdasarkan jenis kata
**Verb + preposition:** misalnya depend on, lead to, result in, result from.
**Adjective + preposition:** misalnya responsible for, interested in, aware of, capable of.
**Noun + preposition:** misalnya an increase/rise in, a reason for, a solution to, an effect/impact on.
Tidak ada jalan pintas di sini -- hafalkan setiap pasangan sebagai satu chunk, bukan dua kata terpisah, dan latih dalam kalimat utuh sampai pasangan itu terasa otomatis, bukan hasil mencari-cari.

blocks.title: Exercise 4.1 · Mengisi Preposition
blocks.instructions: Isi setiap tempat kosong dengan preposition yang benar. Beberapa tempat kosong tidak memerlukan preposition; tulis (0) untuk itu.

items.prompt: The number of tourists rose ______ 20 per cent last year.
The figure grew ______ 5 million ______ 8 million ______ 2015.
Air pollution largely results ______ vehicle emissions.
The government should invest more ______ renewable energy.
She is very interested ______ studying abroad.
Rapid urbanisation has led ______ a housing shortage.
Unemployment peaked ______ 12 per cent ______ 2009.
The success of the plan depends ______ adequate funding.
Many students suffer ______ a lack ______ confidence.
He is responsible ______ managing the entire department.
This problem is closely related ______ poverty.
We must discuss ______ the main causes of the issue.
There has been a sharp increase ______ demand ______ housing.
The committee consists ______ seven members.
The shop is closed ______ Fridays but open ______ the weekend.
Consumption fell ______ a low ______ five units in 2012.
Cities in the region rely heavily ______ agriculture.
The report focuses ______ the effects ______ climate change.
Please enter ______ the hall quietly. (direct object verb)
The two graphs are similar ______ each other.
Students benefit greatly ______ regular feedback.
She applied ______ a scholarship ______ a British university.
A good education is the solution ______ many social problems.
The population has been rising steadily ______ 2000.
According ______ the chart, spending increased sharply.
items.reason: “according to the chart” (sebuah sumber, jadi benar di sini).

blocks: Ringkasan · Menghindari Jebakan Terjemahan dari L1

Preposition menunjukkan sebuah hubungan -- tempat, waktu, atau arah -- dan object-nya datang sesudahnya. Kalau bahasa Inggris Anda terasa sedikit janggal, cek apakah Anda menerjemahkan pola preposition bahasa Bangla secara langsung alih-alih memakai pola tetap bahasa Inggris.

**Mengapa ini penting:** Sebagian besar kesalahan preposition dari penutur bahasa Bangla berasal dari menerjemahkan pola L1 kata demi kata, bukan mempelajari pasangan bahasa Inggris sebagai satu kesatuan tetap.
Preposition terletak sebelum noun atau pronoun dan menunjukkan sebuah hubungan: on the table (tempat), at three (waktu), into the room (arah). Noun yang mengikutinya disebut object-nya.

Setiap kali Anda ragu soal preposition, tahan diri untuk tidak menerjemahkan langsung dari bahasa Bangla. Sebaliknya, ingat frasa tetap bahasa Inggris sebagai satu chunk utuh -- depend on, bukan "depend from" atau "depend of" -- karena preposition bahasa Inggris jarang cocok satu-satu dengan padanannya dalam bahasa Bangla.

blocks.title: Exercise 4.2 · Memperbaiki Terjemahan Langsung dari L1
blocks.instructions: Setiap kalimat mengandung kesalahan preposition karena terjemahan langsung dari bahasa Bangla. Tulis ulang masing-masing dengan benar.

items.prompt: According to me, the government should act quickly.
items.answer: In my opinion, the government should act quickly.
accepted: In my opinion, the government should act quickly.
items.reason: “according to me” salah untuk menyatakan pendapat Anda sendiri.

items.prompt: We discussed about the new policy for an hour.
items.answer: We discussed the new policy for an hour.
accepted: We discussed the new policy for an hour.

items.prompt: He entered into the classroom without knocking.
items.answer: He entered the classroom without knocking.
accepted: He entered the classroom without knocking.

items.prompt: The teacher emphasised on the importance of grammar.
items.answer: The teacher emphasised the importance of grammar.
accepted: The teacher emphasised the importance of grammar.

items.prompt: After the trip, they returned back to their village.
items.answer: After the trip, they returned to their village.
accepted: After the trip, they returned to their village.

items.prompt: The report comprises of five main sections.
items.answer: The report comprises five main sections.
accepted: The report comprises five main sections.

items.prompt: She married with a doctor last year.
items.answer: She married a doctor last year.
accepted: She married a doctor last year.

items.prompt: I want to request to you for some help.
items.answer: I want to ask you for some help.
accepted: I want to ask you for some help.
I want to make a request to you for some help.

items.prompt: The essay mentioned about three possible solutions.
items.answer: The essay mentioned three possible solutions.
accepted: The essay mentioned three possible solutions.

items.prompt: The researchers investigated about the causes of pollution.
items.answer: The researchers investigated the causes of pollution.
accepted: The researchers investigated the causes of pollution.

items.prompt: We must cope up with the rising cost of living.
items.answer: We must cope with the rising cost of living.
accepted: We must cope with the rising cost of living.

items.prompt: The minister reached to the venue an hour late.
items.answer: The minister reached the venue an hour late.
accepted: The minister reached the venue an hour late.

items.prompt: My opinion is different than yours on this matter.
items.answer: My opinion is different from yours on this matter.
accepted: My opinion is different from yours on this matter.
items.reason: “different from” adalah bentuk akademik yang standar.

items.prompt: Students should concentrate in their studies.
items.answer: Students should concentrate on their studies.
accepted: Students should concentrate on their studies.

items.prompt: The country is suffering with severe traffic congestion.
items.answer: The country is suffering from severe traffic congestion.
accepted: The country is suffering from severe traffic congestion.
